name: shiftstart-it-support-kb-jekyll
description: Enterprise-scale, device-optimised technician-first IT support knowledge base built with Jekyll, Tailwind and a multi-select symptom matcher.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run remediate:apply && npm run vendor && npm run generate && npm run css && bundle exec jekyll build && npm run site:artifact:clean
scripts.dev: npm run remediate:apply && npm run vendor && npm run generate && npm run css && concurrently "tailwindcss -i ./_assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/site.css --watch" "bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload"
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-content.js && node scripts/post-remediation-check.js && npm run responsive:check && npm run readiness:check && npm run verification:queue && npm run verification:queue:check && npm run verification:batches && npm run verification:batches:check && npm run verification:evidence:check && npm run sprint1:audit:check && npm run batch:b1:check && npm run batch:b2:check && npm run batch:b3:check && npm run batch:b4:check && npm run batch:b5:check && npm run batch:b6:check && npm run post:b6:governance:check && npm run product:polish:check && npm run final:governance:check
scripts.test: npm run remediate:apply && npm run check && npm run build
scripts.responsive:check: node scripts/validate-responsive.js && node --check assets/js/app.js && node --check assets/js/search.js
